# Niana

> Handmade crochet, leather, and denim bags, made by hand between Slovakia
> and Belgium. Every piece shown is one of one, already made, and sold as
> seen, not made to order, and not configurable.

Niana is a small studio run by Nina Hajdíková. This website is a
catalogue, not a checkout: to ask about or buy a piece, contact Niana
directly on Instagram (@niana.bags) or by email, see /imprint.

## Pages

- [Home](https://niana.bags/): studio introduction and new arrivals
- [Collection](https://niana.bags/collection): every current piece, filterable by material (crochet, leather, denim, custom)
- [About](https://niana.bags/about): the studio, materials, and process
- [Privacy Policy](https://niana.bags/privacy)
- [Imprint](https://niana.bags/imprint)
- [Terms of Use](https://niana.bags/terms)

## Notes for automated crawlers

No user accounts, no on-site payments, no cookies, no analytics. Product
pages (/collection/:slug) each describe a single specific, already-made
item — not a general product type with variants.
